title: द्वादशाधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 112 · Galava goes to King Yayati

summary.en: Finding no such horses, Garuda takes the despairing Galava to his friend King Yayati, a great giver, and asks him for help. Garuda says Galava is a worthy receiver and Yayati a worthy giver, like milk poured into a conch.
summary.kn: ಅಂಥ ಕುದುರೆಗಳು ಸಿಗದೆ ನಿರಾಶನಾದ ಗಾಲವನನ್ನು ಗರುಡನು ತನ್ನ ಮಿತ್ರ ಮಹಾದಾನಿ ಯಯಾತಿರಾಜನ ಬಳಿಗೆ ಕರೆದೊಯ್ದು ಸಹಾಯ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಶಂಖದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಾಲು ಸುರಿದಂತೆ ಗಾಲವನು ಯೋಗ್ಯ ಪ್ರತಿಗ್ರಾಹಿ, ಯಯಾತಿ ಯೋಗ್ಯ ದಾನಿ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾನೆ ಗರುಡ.
summary.hi: ऐसे घोड़े न मिलने पर गरुड़ निराश गालव को अपने मित्र, महान दानी राजा ययाति के पास ले जाकर सहायता माँगते हैं। गरुड़ कहते हैं कि गालव योग्य पात्र हैं और ययाति योग्य दाता, जैसे शंख में दूध डाला जाए।
summary.te: అలాంటి గుర్రాలు దొరకక నిరాశపడిన గాలవుని గరుడుడు తన మిత్రుడు, మహాదాత యయాతిరాజు దగ్గరకు తీసుకువెళ్లి సహాయం అడుగుతాడు. శంఖంలో పాలు పోసినట్లు గాలవుడు యోగ్యమైన గ్రహీత, యయాతి యోగ్యమైన దాత అని గరుడుడు అంటాడు.
summary.ta: அத்தகைய குதிரைகள் கிடைக்காமல் நம்பிக்கை இழந்த காலவனைக் கருடன் தன் நண்பனான பெருங்கொடையாளி யயாதி மன்னனிடம் அழைத்துச் சென்று உதவி கேட்கிறான். சங்கில் பால் ஊற்றியது போல் காலவன் தகுந்த பெறுநன், யயாதி தகுந்த கொடையாளி என்கிறான் கருடன்.
summary.ml: അത്തരം കുതിരകളെ കണ്ടെത്താനാകാതെ, നിരാശനായ ഗാലവനെ ഗരുഡൻ മഹാദാനശീലനായ സുഹൃത്ത് യയാതി രാജാവിന്റെ അടുത്തേക്ക് കൊണ്ടുപോകുന്നു; സഹായം ചോദിക്കാൻ പറയുന്നു. ഗാലവൻ യോഗ്യനായ സ്വീകർത്താവും യയാതി യോഗ്യനായ ദാതാവും ആണെന്ന് ഗരുഡൻ പറയുന്നു; ശംഖിലേക്ക് ഒഴിച്ച പാൽ പോലെയാണത്.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 5.112; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jan 23 2024

verses.text: नारद उवाच

meaning.en: Narada said:

verses.text:
अथाह गालवं दीनं सुपर्णः पततां वरः ।
निर्मितं वह्निना भूमौ वायुना वैधितं तथा ।
यस्माद्धिरण्मयं सर्वं हिरण्यं तेन चोच्यते ॥

meaning.en: Then Garuda, best of fliers, said to the wretched Galava: 'Gold was made on earth by fire and increased by wind; because all of it is golden, it is called hiranya.

verses.text:
धत्ते धारयते चेदमेतस्मात्कारणाद्धनम् ।
तदेतत्त्रिषु लोकेषु धनं तिष्ठति शाश्वतम् ॥

meaning.en: For this reason it holds and sustains this world, and so it is called wealth. This wealth stands eternal in the three worlds.

verses.text:
नित्यं प्रोष्ठपदाभ्यां च शुक्रे धनपतौ तथा ।
मनुष्येभ्यः समादत्ते शुक्रश्चित्तार्जितं धनम् ॥

meaning.en: Always, under the Proshthapada stars and in the planet Venus, the lord of wealth, Shukra takes from men the wealth won by their intent.

verses.text:
अजैकपादहिर्बुध्न्यै रक्ष्यते धनदेन च ।
एवं न शक्यते लब्धुमलब्धव्यं द्विजर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: It is guarded by Aja Ekapada, Ahirbudhnya and the giver of wealth, Kubera. So, bull among brahmins, what cannot be had cannot be obtained.

verses.text:
ऋते च धनमश्वानां नावाप्तिर्विद्यते तव ।
अर्थं याचात्र राजानं कंचिद्राजर्षिवंशजम् ।
अपीड्य राजा पौरान्हि यो नौ कुर्यात्कृतार्थिनौ ॥

meaning.en: Without wealth you cannot obtain the horses. Ask for the wealth from some king born of a royal sage's line, one who can make us both succeed without oppressing his citizens.

verses.text:
अस्ति सोमान्ववाये मे जातः कश्चिन्नृपः सखा ।
अभिगच्छावहे तं वै तस्यास्ति विभवो भुवि ॥

meaning.en: I have a friend, a king born in the lunar line. Let us go to him, for he has wealth on earth.

verses.text:
ययातिर्नाम राजर्षिर्नाहुषः सत्यविक्रमः ।
स दास्यति मया चोक्तो भवता चार्थितः स्वयम् ॥

meaning.en: He is the royal sage Yayati, son of Nahusha, of true valor. If I ask him, and you yourself beg, he will give.

verses.text:
विभवश्चास्य सुमहानासीद्धनपतेरिव ।
एवं स तु धनं विद्वान्दानेनैव व्यशोधयत् ॥

meaning.en: His wealth was once as great as the lord of wealth's. And so, knowing wealth, he purified it by giving alone.'

verses.text:
तथा तौ कथयन्तौ च चिन्तयन्तौ च यत्क्षमम् ।
प्रतिष्ठाने नरपतिं ययातिं प्रत्युपस्थितौ ॥

meaning.en: So they spoke together and thought about what would be proper, and arrived before King Yayati at Pratishthana.

verses.text:
प्रतिगृह्य च सत्कारमर्घादिं भोजनं वरम् ।
पृष्टश्चागमने हेतुमुवाच विनतासुतः ॥

meaning.en: After accepting honor, the guest-gift and the best food, and being asked the reason for his coming, Vinata's son said:

verses.text:
अयं मे नाहुष सखा गालवस्तपसो निधिः ।
विश्वामित्रस्य शिष्योऽभूद्वर्षाण्ययुतशो नृप ॥

meaning.en: 'Son of Nahusha, this friend of mine, Galava, a treasury of austerity, was for tens of thousands of years a pupil of Vishvamitra, king.

verses.text:
सोऽयं तेनाभ्यनुज्ञात उपकारेप्सया द्विजः ।
तमाह भगवान्कां ते ददानि गुरुदक्षिणाम् ॥

meaning.en: Given leave by him, the brahmin wished to repay, and said to him, 'Lord, what teacher's fee shall I give you?'

verses.text:
असकृत्तेन चोक्तेन किंचिदागतमन्युना ।
अयमुक्तः प्रयच्छेति जानता विभवं लघु ॥

meaning.en: Asked again and again, Vishvamitra, becoming a little angry, though he knew the man's lack of means, said to him, 'Give.'

verses.text:
एकतःश्यामकर्णानां शुभ्राणां शुद्धजन्मनाम् ।
अष्टौ शतानि मे देहि हयानां चन्द्रवर्चसाम् ॥

meaning.en: 'Give me eight hundred horses, white as the moon, of pure birth, each with one black ear.

verses.text:
गुर्वर्थो दीयतामेष यदि गालव मन्यसे ।
इत्येवमाह सक्रोधो विश्वामित्रस्तपोधनः ॥

meaning.en: Let this be given as the teacher's fee, Galava, if you agree.' So the ascetic Vishvamitra said in anger.

verses.text:
सोऽयं शोकेन महता तप्यमानो द्विजर्षभः ।
अशक्तः प्रतिकर्तुं तद्भवन्तं शरणं गतः ॥

meaning.en: This best of brahmins, burning with great grief and unable to repay, has come to you for refuge.

verses.text:
प्रतिगृह्य नरव्याघ्र त्वत्तो भिक्षां गतव्यथः ।
कृत्वापवर्गं गुरवे चरिष्यति महत्तपः ॥

meaning.en: Accepting alms from you, tiger among men, he will be free of his distress and, having completed the fee to his teacher, will practice great austerity.

verses.text:
तपसः संविभागेन भवन्तमपि योक्ष्यते ।
स्वेन राजर्षितपसा पूर्णं त्वां पूरयिष्यति ॥

meaning.en: He will give you a share of the merit of his austerity as well, and by his own royal-sage austerity he will fill you who are already full.

verses.text:
यावन्ति रोमाणि हये भवन्ति हि नरेश्वर ।
तावतो वाजिदा लोकान्प्राप्नुवन्ति महीपते ॥

meaning.en: As many hairs as a horse has, lord of men, so many worlds does the giver of horses attain, king.

verses.text:
पात्रं प्रतिग्रहस्यायं दातुं पात्रं तथा भवान् ।
शङ्खे क्षीरमिवासक्तं भवत्वेतत्तथोपमम् ॥

meaning.en: He is a fit recipient and you are a fit giver. Let it be like milk poured into a conch.'
